part7_and_8_live_artifact_isolation_hard.incident_context: P3G test incident: an older test unconditionally called DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH.unlink(), deleting the real live attempt ledger during a routine full-suite run. Already fixed in the P3G commit; this milestone adds a STRUCTURAL guard on top of that fix, not just the removal of the one bad call.
part7_and_8_live_artifact_isolation_hard.hardening_mechanism: new _resolve_path_under_test() helper in scripts/run_b2n_p3c_migration_lineage_run.py: if a caller does not supply an explicit ledger_path/event_ledger_path AND the code is running under pytest (sys.modules contains 'pytest'), the call is REJECTED with B2N_P3H_TEST_MUST_SUPPLY_EXPLICIT_<LEDGER|EVENT_LEDGER>_PATH rather than silently falling back to the canonical live default path. Wired into dry_run(), live_run(), and resume_run().
part7_and_8_live_artifact_isolation_hard.audit_of_all_test_call_sites: grepped every dry_run()/live_run()/resume_run() invocation across tests/*.py; found 4 call sites in tests/test_b2n_p3c_execution_preflight.py that supplied ledger_path but omitted event_ledger_path (relying on the call raising for an unrelated reason -- digest mismatch, missing credential, provenance closure, or a duplicate on the explicit ledger_path -- before ever reaching the event-ledger check). All 4 fixed to pass explicit tmp_path-scoped event_ledger_path as well, so correctness no longer depends on incidental code ordering.
part7_and_8_live_artifact_isolation_hard.main_cli_entrypoint_risk: main() (the CLI --live/--resume path) still defaults --output/DEFAULT_RESULT_PATH when no --output/--ledger-path/--event-ledger-path flags are given -- this is CORRECT and INTENTIONAL for real human invocation (durable-by-default), and is structurally unreachable from any test in this suite, since no test calls main() directly (confirmed by grep).
